location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, career advice office
location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，職涯諮詢室

goal.en: Ask the career advisor to check your resume and learn how to make it stronger.
goal.zh: 請職涯顧問看你的履歷，學會怎麼把它寫得更有力。

background: small career advice office at a language school, wooden desk with a laptop and loose blank papers, shelf of plain binders, potted plant, window with soft afternoon light

intro.en: An email from Rachel at Brightway: please apply online by Friday and attach an updated resume.
intro.zh: Brightway 的瑞秋寄來一封信：請在星期五前上網應徵，並附上更新過的履歷。

intro.en: You open your old resume and sigh. Time to visit the school's career office.
intro.zh: 你打開舊履歷，嘆了一口氣。該去學校的職涯諮詢室一趟了。

lines.en: Come on in, Kai. I'm Mr. Hayes. What can I do for you today?
lines.zh: 請進，凱。我是海斯先生。今天有什麼需要幫忙的？

choices.en: Could you help me look my resume? It's urgent.
choices.zh: 你可以幫我看履歷嗎？很急。

lines.en: Look your resume? You mean look at it? Or look for it? Did you lose it?
lines.zh: 看你的履歷？你是說看一下？還是找它？你弄丟了嗎？

story.en: Mr. Hayes starts searching his desk for your lost resume. It takes a while to explain that it is safely in your bag.
story.zh: 海斯先生開始在桌上翻找你「弄丟的」履歷。你解釋了好一陣子，他才知道履歷好好地在你包包裡。

fail.why: look 後面接東西要加 at：look at my resume。請人幫忙看文件，最自然的說法是 Could you take a look at my resume?。

choices.en: Could you take a look at my resume before I send it?
choices.zh: 在我寄出之前，你可以幫我看一下履歷嗎？
choices.tip: Could you take a look at...? 是請別人幫忙看東西最常用的客氣說法。

choices.en: Fix my resume for me. Brightway needs it by Friday.
choices.zh: 幫我改履歷。Brightway 星期五前要。

lines.en: I'm happy to give advice, Kai, but I'm not your personal typist.
lines.zh: 凱，我很樂意給建議，但我不是你的私人打字員。

story.en: Mr. Hayes hands you a pen and a long checklist. You spend the evening fixing everything alone.
story.zh: 海斯先生遞給你一支筆和一張長長的檢查清單。你一個人改到晚上。

fail.why: 用命令句要求別人幫你做事，聽起來很沒禮貌，好像對方理所當然要替你做。請人幫忙要用問句：Could you take a look at my resume?。

lines.en: Mr. Hayes flips through the pages. Then he flips back again.
lines.zh: 海斯先生翻了翻履歷，又翻回前面。

lines.en: Hmm. It's three pages long, and it has your photo, your birthday and your height on it.
lines.zh: 嗯，它有三頁長，上面還有你的照片、生日和身高。

choices.en: Is that a problem? How can I improve it?
choices.zh: 這樣有問題嗎？我可以怎麼改進？
choices.tip: How can I improve...? 主動請教改進方法，顯示你願意學習。

choices.en: Yes, I'm 175 centimeters. Is that tall in Maple Bay?
choices.zh: 對，我 175 公分。這在楓灣算高嗎？

lines.en: Um... about average, I suppose? But that's not really my point.
lines.zh: 呃……大概算普通吧？不過我的重點不是這個。

story.en: The two of you have a surprisingly long chat about average heights around the world. Your resume stays three pages long.
story.zh: 你們兩個意外聊了很久世界各國的平均身高。你的履歷還是三頁長。

fail.why: 顧問列出照片、生日、身高，是在暗示這些「不該放」，不是在問你的身高。聽到問題點時，接著問 Is that a problem? How can I improve it?。

choices.en: Should I add that I'm single too? We do in Taiwan.
choices.zh: 我要不要也寫我單身？在台灣都會寫。

lines.en: Please don't! Here, employers aren't even allowed to ask about that.
lines.zh: 千萬不要！在這裡，雇主連問都不能問這個。

story.en: Mr. Hayes takes off his glasses and gives you a twenty-minute talk on fair hiring laws. You learn a lot, but your resume is still not done.
story.zh: 海斯先生摘下眼鏡，給你上了二十分鐘的公平僱用法規課。你學到很多，但履歷還是沒改完。

fail.why: 台灣履歷常放照片、生日、婚姻狀況，但在許多英語系國家，這些資訊可能造成歧視疑慮，雇主不希望看到。履歷只放和工作有關的內容，再問 How can I improve it?。

lines.en: First, cut it to one page. Now, your café job. You wrote: 'I was responsible for the cash register.' Can you make that stronger?
lines.zh: 首先，刪到一頁。再來是你的咖啡店工作。你寫「I was responsible for the cash register.」，可以寫得更有力嗎？

choices.en: It's fine. Nobody reads resumes carefully anyway.
choices.zh: 這樣就好啦，反正沒人會仔細看履歷。

lines.en: Recruiters read hundreds of them, Kai. About six seconds each. Make those seconds count.
lines.zh: 凱，招募人員要看幾百份履歷，每份大概只看六秒。你得讓那六秒有價值。

story.en: Mr. Hayes sets a timer for six seconds and hands you a stranger's resume. You remember nothing. Point taken.
story.zh: 海斯先生設了六秒計時，遞給你一份陌生人的履歷。時間到，你什麼都記不得。你懂了。

fail.why: 對顧問的建議回「反正沒人看」很失禮，而且招募人員只花幾秒掃履歷，所以更需要有力的動詞。可以改成 Handled payments for 200 customers a day.。

choices.en: How about 'Handled payments for 200 customers a day'?
choices.zh: 改成「每天為 200 位客人處理結帳」如何？
choices.tip: 履歷用動作動詞開頭，例如 Handled、Managed，再加上數字，成果一目了然。

choices.en: How about 'I responsibled for the cash register every day'?
choices.zh: 改成「我每天負責收銀機」如何？

lines.en: Responsibled? I'm afraid that's not a word.

story.en: Mr. Hayes circles the word in red, then circles it again. Your resume now looks like a homework assignment.
story.zh: 海斯先生用紅筆把那個字圈起來，又圈了一次。你的履歷現在看起來像批改過的作業。

fail.why: responsible 是形容詞，不能加 -ed 當動詞用。要寫得有力，就換成動作動詞：Handled payments for 200 customers a day.。

lines.en: Much better! Numbers make it real. Now, your design studio job says 'Helped my boss with social media.'
lines.zh: 好多了！有數字就有說服力。再來，你在設計工作室的經歷寫的是「幫老闆處理社群媒體」。

choices.en: Maybe 'Created posts that grew our followers by 30%'?
choices.zh: 也許改成「製作貼文，讓追蹤人數成長 30%」？
choices.tip: Created、Grew、Designed 這類動詞直接說出你的貢獻，比 Helped 有力得多。

choices.en: Honestly, my boss was lazy, so I did everything myself.
choices.zh: 老實說，我老闆很懶，所以全部都是我自己做。

lines.en: Careful. Say that in an interview, and they'll wonder what you'll say about them someday.
lines.zh: 小心。面試時這樣說，他們會想你以後會怎麼說他們。

story.en: Mr. Hayes writes 'NEVER badmouth a boss' at the top of your page in big red letters. It's a good tip, but now you need a new copy.
story.zh: 海斯先生在你履歷最上方用紅筆大大寫了「絕對不要說前老闆壞話」。建議很好，但你得重印一份了。

fail.why: 抱怨前老闆會讓人擔心你以後也這樣說新公司。把功勞用動作動詞寫出來就好：Created posts that grew our followers by 30%.。

choices.en: Maybe 'Helped boss do Facebook and Instagram, very hard'?
choices.zh: 也許改成「幫老闆做臉書和 IG，很辛苦」？

lines.en: It still sounds like you were just helping out. What did you actually do?
lines.zh: 聽起來還是只是在幫忙。你實際上做了什麼？

story.en: Mr. Hayes reads it three times and still can't tell what your job was. Neither will Brightway.
story.zh: 海斯先生讀了三遍，還是看不出你的工作是什麼。Brightway 也一樣看不出來。

fail.why: 「幫老闆做臉書，很辛苦」直譯成英文，只看得出辛苦，看不出成果。用 Created、Designed、Grew 開頭，再加上數字，例如 Created posts that grew our followers by 30%.。

lines.en: This is really coming together. Anything else before you send it to Brightway?
lines.zh: 越來越像樣了。寄給 Brightway 之前，還有別的事嗎？

choices.en: Should I add 'can work overtime anytime, no extra pay'?
choices.zh: 我要不要加上「隨時可配合加班，不用加班費」？

lines.en: Absolutely not! That tells them you don't value your own time.
lines.zh: 絕對不要！這等於告訴他們你不重視自己的時間。

story.en: Mr. Hayes looks so shocked that he spills his coffee. You help clean it up, and the line never makes it onto your resume.
story.zh: 海斯先生嚇得打翻了咖啡。你幫忙擦乾淨，那句話也永遠沒出現在履歷上。

fail.why: 台灣履歷常寫「配合度高、可配合加班」，但在這裡，自願無償加班會讓人覺得你不懂保護自己，甚至讓雇主擔心違法。想表達彈性，寫 Flexible with schedules 就夠了。

choices.en: Could you also check my cover letter, please?
choices.zh: 可以也請你看看我的求職信嗎？
choices.tip: Could you also check...? 用 also 自然地多提一個請求。

choices.en: Could you also help me see see my cover letter?
choices.zh: 可以也幫我看看我的求職信嗎？

lines.en: See see? Ha, you mean have a look? Of course.
lines.zh: See see？哈，你是說看一下嗎？當然好。

story.en: Mr. Hayes laughs so hard he has to take off his glasses. He adds 'see see' to his list of favorite student moments.
story.zh: 海斯先生笑到得摘下眼鏡。他把「see see」加進他的學生經典語錄清單。

fail.why: 中文用「看看」讓語氣變輕鬆，但英文動詞不能重複。請人幫忙看東西說 Could you check...? 或 Could you take a look at...?。

lines.en: Mr. Hayes prints your new one-page resume and hands it back with a nod.
lines.zh: 海斯先生印出你的新版一頁履歷，點點頭遞還給你。

lines.en: Now that's a resume I'd want to read. Go send it to Brightway!
lines.zh: 這才是我會想讀的履歷。快寄給 Brightway 吧！

story.en: Three pages became one, and every line now shows what you can do. You click Submit with a smile.
story.zh: 三頁變成一頁，每一行都在說明你能做什麼。你笑著按下送出。

notes.en: Could you take a look at...?
notes.explain: 請別人幫忙看文件的客氣說法。注意 look 後面要加 at，不能說 look my resume。

example.en: Could you take a look at my cover letter?
example.zh: 可以請你看一下我的求職信嗎？

notes.explain: 主動請教改進方法，比只問「這樣可以嗎？」更能得到具體建議。

example.en: How can I improve this part?
example.zh: 這個部分我可以怎麼改進？

notes.en: Action verbs: handled, managed, created, organized
notes.zh: 動作動詞：處理、管理、製作、籌辦
notes.explain: 履歷每一條經歷用動作動詞的過去式開頭，再加上數字或成果，例如人數、百分比。少用 I was responsible for 或 Helped。

example.en: Organized three product photo shoots a month.
example.zh: 每月籌辦三場商品攝影。

notes.explain: 英文動詞不能像中文「看看」一樣重複；responsible 是形容詞，不能加 -ed。換成 check、handled 這類真正的動詞。

example.en: Could you check my resume? I handled all the orders.
example.zh: 你可以幫我看履歷嗎？所有訂單都是我處理的。

notes.en: No photo, birthday or marital status
notes.zh: 不放照片、生日、婚姻狀況
notes.explain: 在許多英語系國家，為了避免歧視，履歷通常不放照片、生日、身高、婚姻狀況，篇幅以一頁為主。也別寫「可無償加班」。

example.en: Keep it to one page and focus on your skills.
example.zh: 控制在一頁，聚焦在你的能力上。
